I’ve been going to Chiwi Clinic for about 4 years, and I’ve always had a great experience with the treatments and the staff. That’s why it makes me a little sad to write this.

Recently, scheduling appointments has become much more difficult. I often have to reschedule or I’m told that the schedule is already full. I completely understand that and scheduling isn’t easy ,so I don’t blame the staff for that.

I also want to say that the new staff are kind and professional. This isn’t a complaint about them at all. I think I just got used to the previous staff, who made scheduling feel much smoother and easier over the years. I really miss that level of convenience.

I still enjoy coming to Chiwi Clinic and appreciate the care I receive. I just hope the appointment scheduling process can improve in the future so it becomes as convenient as it used to be.
